verification_report.summary: Under the stated excerpt-fidelity assumption, the proof establishes both comparison assertions: canonical normalized I-model reconstruction without positive mass, and a single I-class carrying masses 1−s, including the zero-mass endpoint. The essential inputs match [Boucksom’s notes](https://sebastien.boucksom.perso.math.cnrs.fr/notes/L2.pdf), [Guan–Zhou](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1401.7158), [BEGZ](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0812.3674), and [Kellay–Mashreghi, formula (3.4)](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1102.5596). The stated exclusions and P14.8’s open status are preserved. No ancestor expansion is needed.
